verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines are a fair question to ask of a laptop APU with an integrated GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents on-chip AV1, HEVC or ProRes-class encode or decode. The available items cover AI/NPU software, cTDP, display count and memory, none of which addresses media engines.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself
